monetization.reason: No approved affiliate program or tracking ID is configured in the repository. The conversion improvement is a product-neutral dehumidifier decision and acceptance-test system covering measured moisture load, capacity conditions, efficiency, drainage, operating range, electrical fit, recalls, returns, and first-year cost. No merchant, model, live price, discount, ranking, availability claim, fabricated test, product image, paid placement, or generic product link was added; correcting the moisture source, using supported existing equipment, or buying nothing remains a valid outcome.

image_qa.note: The two new articles and Arkansas expansion use original text, evidence tables, checklists, and existing brand interface assets. No patient, cannabis product, PAP device, dehumidifier, merchant, affiliate, stock image, product photo, or generated image was added or changed, so there is no exact-product mismatch or new licensing issue.

search_console.decision: The October 12–November 8 report is one day old and valid: 815 impressions, three clicks, 0.368% CTR, and average position 24.093. The Arkansas legal page had six impressions, one click, 16.7% CTR, and average position 9.667—the only page-level signal with more than a token sample in the target 4–20 band—so the Data-led item preserves that URL while adding current patient, renewal, caregiver, visiting-patient, dispensary, and primary-source workflows. ‘510 vs disposable’ had two impressions at position 12 but already maps to an existing page; Delaware had two impressions and one click; Blue Dream impressions averaged about position 48; single-impression legal and health rows were too weak. Those signals were deliberately ignored as duplicative, tiny, or out of range.

authority.action: Published a citation-worthy sleep-apnea evidence translator with an outcome-lane matrix, study-transfer screen, clinician handoff, conservative next-day task gate, and current AASM, NIH/NCCIH, NHLBI, and peer-reviewed sources. Reciprocal links strengthen the sleep, next-day impairment, medication-interaction, and clinician-conversation cluster. The Arkansas page also adds a primary-source role map. No speculative outreach target was logged and no outreach was sent.
